description: This Java class defines enumerations and methods for handling share account statuses, share purchase statuses, frequency types, and dividend statuses within the share accounts domain of the Fineract project.

classes.name: SharesEnumerations
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to convert enumeration types into data objects for representing share account statuses, purchase statuses, frequency types, and dividend statuses.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns a ShareAccountStatusEnumData object based on the integer or enum ShareAccountStatusType, representing the current status of a share account.

methods.name: purchasedSharesEnum
methods.description: Provides an EnumOptionData object for a given PurchasedSharesStatusType, representing purchase status options.

methods.name: purchasedSharesEnum (overload)
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData for a given integer value by converting it to PurchasedSharesStatusType.

methods.name: lockinPeriodFrequencyType
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData representing the share lock-in period frequency type based on an integer id.

methods.name: minimumActivePeriodFrequencyType
methods.description: Provides an EnumOptionData for the minimum active period frequency type based on an enum value.

methods.name: shareAccountDividendStatusEnum
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData for the share account dividend status type.

methods.name: shareAccountDividendStatusEnum (overload)
methods.description: Provides an EnumOptionData for a dividend status based on an integer value.

methods.name: shareProductDividendStatusEnum
methods.description: Returns an EnumOptionData for the share product dividend status type.

methods.name: shareProductDividendStatusEnum (overload)
methods.description: Provides an EnumOptionData based on an integer value for share product dividend status.
